firstPlayerRule: In the standard four-player game, whoever opened the box is the first round's starting player. That player and the opponent opposite them plan first.
officialTieBreak: In the three-player variant, the lower-scoring member of the two-person team starts alongside the solo player; roll a die if those teammates are tied. The die also breaks lowest-score ties when selecting a starter for later rounds.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: During the four-player build, two players plan while their partners wait to build, then the roles switch. There is not a single player taking the whole opening turn alone.
The box-opening instruction applies to the first round. Later rounds use the lowest score.
